label: FP
reason: The user-provided value is decoded and assigned to bar via URL decoding, but the conditional logic in doSomething ensures that bar is set to param only when (500/42) + num > 200. Since (500/42) ≈ 11.9 and 11.9 + 196 = 207.9 > 200, the guard condition is always true, meaning param reaches bar. However, the sink uses ESAPI.encodeForHTML() on the input string, which safely encodes the content before writing to response. The vulnerability claim of XSS is invalid because the output is properly encoded against XSS attacks.

evidence.note: User input flows through decode and conditional assignment, but is encoded before being written to response
